eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land. Institutional landholders, income tax payers and a few other excluded categories are not eligible.
benefits: Rs 6,000 per year paid as three equal instalments of Rs 2,000 directly into the bank account.
how_to_apply: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or through the village agriculture office or a Common Service Centre; complete eKYC.
documents_required: Aadhaar, bank passbook, land records (Khasra/Khatauni), mobile number.

eligibility: Farmers - owners, tenants, sharecroppers - and SHG or joint liability group members engaged in crop production and allied activities.
benefits: Short-term crop credit up to Rs 3 lakh at a 7 percent interest rate, reduced to about 4 percent with prompt repayment subvention; flexible withdrawals through the card.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank branch or on the bank website with land and crop details.
documents_required: Land records, identity proof, photographs, crop plan, bank account.

eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with a valid agreement.
benefits: Insurance cover against crop loss from natural calamities, pests and diseases; premium is only 2 percent for kharif, 1.5 percent for rabi and 5 percent for commercial and horticultural crops.
how_to_apply: Enrol through the bank, a Common Service Centre, or the PMFBY portal before the season cut-off date.
documents_required: Land record or tenancy agreement, Aadhaar, bank account details.

eligibility: All farmers; soil samples are collected in a grid pattern from individual holdings every two years.
benefits: Free soil testing and a card with fertiliser recommendations for 12 nutrients, which improves yield and reduces fertiliser cost.
how_to_apply: Contact the village agriculture assistant or the local agriculture department office for sample collection.
documents_required: Land details; the test itself is free of cost.

eligibility: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 who own up to 2 hectares of cultivable land.
benefits: Assured pension of Rs 3,000 per month after the age of 60; the central government matches the farmer's monthly contribution of Rs 55 to Rs 200.
how_to_apply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre or on the Maandhan portal with eKYC and a savings account for auto-debit.
documents_required: Aadhaar, land records, bank account, mobile number.

eligibility: Farmers, traders and farmer producer organisations registered on the platform whose produce can be graded.
benefits: Online trading across 1,000 plus regulated mandis with transparent price discovery and online payment directly to the seller's bank account.
how_to_apply: Register on the e-NAM portal or mobile app, or through the nearest e-NAM mandi.
documents_required: Aadhaar, bank account details, land record for farmer registration.

eligibility: Farmers or farmer groups willing to adopt organic farming in clusters of 20 hectares.
benefits: Assistance of Rs 50,000 per hectare over three years for organic inputs, certification and marketing; Rs 31,000 of it goes directly to the farmer.
how_to_apply: Form or join a cluster through the district agriculture office or a participating organic produce company.
documents_required: Land records, Aadhaar, bank details, group formation documents.

eligibility: Farmers, farmer producer organisations, primary agricultural credit societies, agri-entrepreneurs and startups creating post-harvest infrastructure.
benefits: Medium and long-term loans up to Rs 2 crore with 3 percent interest subvention and credit guarantee cover; repayment up to seven years.
how_to_apply: Apply online on the AIF portal with a project report; connected banks sanction the loan.
documents_required: Project report, land documents, KYC documents, bank statements.

eligibility: Farmers in implementation areas; priority to small and marginal farmers and water-stressed districts.
benefits: Subsidy of 55 percent for small and marginal farmers and 45 percent for others on micro-irrigation such as drip and sprinkler systems, plus support for water conveyance.
how_to_apply: Apply through the district horticulture or agriculture department or the state micro-irrigation portal.
documents_required: Land record, Aadhaar, bank passbook, electricity connection for the pump.

eligibility: Individual farmers, cooperatives, panchayats and farmer producer organisations; water-stressed areas get priority.
benefits: Up to 60 percent subsidy (30 percent central plus 30 percent state) for standalone solar pumps and solarisation of existing pumps; surplus power can be sold to the DISCOM.
how_to_apply: Apply through the state renewable energy nodal agency or the designated state portal.
documents_required: Land records, pump connection details, Aadhaar, bank account.

eligibility: Dairy farmers and cattle rearers, reached through state livestock development boards and artificial insemination centres.
benefits: Support for scientific cattle breeding through artificial insemination, breed improvement, heifer rearing programmes and better milk yield.
how_to_apply: Contact the district animal husbandry office or the state livestock development board.
documents_required: Aadhaar, bank details, cattle ownership details where applicable.

eligibility: Groups of about 300 or more farmers can form a farmer producer organisation with support from a Cluster-Based Business Organisation.
benefits: Equity grant up to Rs 15 lakh per FPO, matching equity grant up to Rs 2,000 per farmer member, and credit guarantee for loans.
how_to_apply: Register the FPO through an empanelled Cluster-Based Business Organisation under the agriculture ministry.
documents_required: FPO registration, member list, bank account, business plan.

eligibility: Students of class 9 in government, local body or aided schools with at least 55 percent marks and family income up to Rs 3.5 lakh per year.
benefits: Scholarship of Rs 12,000 per year (Rs 1,000 per month) from class 9 to class 12 to reduce dropout after class 8.
how_to_apply: Apply through the school; the state conducts the selection test, and renewal needs 55 percent each year.
documents_required: Income certificate, marksheets, caste certificate if applicable, bank account.

eligibility: OBC, EBC and Denotified/Nomadic tribe students of class 9 or 11 in recognised schools with family income below Rs 2.5 lakh per year.
benefits: Scholarship of about Rs 4,000 to 7,000 per year for school expenses including hostel costs.
how_to_apply: Apply for the YASASVI entrance test on the NTA portal in the announced window.
documents_required: Caste and income certificates, marksheets, Aadhaar, bank account.

eligibility: Top merit students of class 12 board examinations pursuing regular graduation or postgraduation, family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh, not holding another scholarship.
benefits: Rs 10,000 per year at graduation level and Rs 20,000 per year at postgraduation level.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal after joining the course; renewal needs 60 percent marks.
documents_required: Class 12 marksheet, income certificate, admission proof, bank account, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Any student seeking an education loan for higher studies in India or abroad.
benefits: One portal to view, apply and track education loans of multiple banks, plus links to government scholarships.
how_to_apply: Register on the portal and fill the Common Education Loan Application Form.
documents_required: Admission letter, fee structure, KYC documents, income proof as per bank norms.

eligibility: Meritorious students admitted to quality higher education institutions notified by the government.
benefits: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loans up to Rs 7.5 lakh with a 75 percent credit guarantee, and 3 percent interest subvention for loans up to Rs 10 lakh for families with income up to Rs 8 lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Vidya Lakshmi portal or the lending bank.
documents_required: Admission proof, KYC documents, income certificate, fee structure.

eligibility: Girl students (maximum two per family) in the first year of an AICTE-approved diploma or degree technical course, family income up to Rs 8 lakh.
benefits: Rs 50,000 per year for the whole course to cover tuition, books, equipment and a laptop.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal in the announced window through the institute.
documents_required: Income certificate, admission proof, marksheets, bank account, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Specially-abled students with 40 percent or more disability in the first year of an AICTE-approved diploma or degree course.
benefits: Rs 50,000 per year for the whole course to meet academic and accessibility expenses.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal with the disability certificate.
documents_required: Disability certificate, admission proof, marksheets, bank account, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Scheduled caste students of class 9 and 10 with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh per year.
benefits: Scholarship of Rs 3,500 per year for day scholars and Rs 7,000 for hostellers, plus a book grant for class 9 and 10.
how_to_apply: Apply through the school on the National Scholarship Portal.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, marksheets, bank account, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Scheduled caste students of recognised post-matriculation or post-secondary courses with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh per year.
benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory fees plus a maintenance allowance of Rs 230 to Rs 1,200 per month depending on the course and hostel status.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal through the institution each year.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, fee receipt, marksheets, bank account.

eligibility: Other backward class students of recognised post-matriculation courses with family income up to Rs 2.5 lakh per year.
benefits: Reimbursement of compulsory fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance that varies by course stage.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal through the institution each year.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, fee receipt, marksheets, bank account.

eligibility: Students in integrated or direct PhD and M.Tech-PhD tracks at IITs, IISc, NITs, IISERs and other notified institutions, selected through the PMRF procedure.
benefits: Fellowship of Rs 70,000 to Rs 80,000 per month depending on the year, plus a research grant of Rs 2 lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply through the institution after admission; selection considers academic record and research aptitude.
documents_required: Academic transcripts, research proposal, institute nomination documents.

scheme_name: Top Class Education for SC Students
eligibility: Scheduled caste students admitted to notified premier institutions with family income up to Rs 8 lakh per year.
benefits: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges, living expenses, books and a computer allowance.
how_to_apply: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal after admission to a notified institution.
documents_required: Caste certificate, income certificate, admission proof, fee structure, bank account.

eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 or above for the first living child, and for the second child if it is a girl.
benefits: Rs 5,000 in instalments directly into the mother's bank account to compensate wage loss and support nutrition and rest before and after birth.
how_to_apply: Register at the anganwadi centre or on the PMMVY portal, ideally within 150 days of the last menstrual period.
documents_required: Mother-child protection card, Aadhaar, the woman's bank account details.

eligibility: Legal guardian can open an account for a girl child below 10 years; maximum two accounts per family.
benefits: High fixed interest rate, tax-free returns, deposits from Rs 250 to Rs 1.5 lakh a year; half withdrawal for education at 18 and maturity at 21 years.
how_to_apply: Open the account at any post office or authorised bank branch in the girl's name.
documents_required: Girl's birth certificate, guardian's KYC documents, photographs.

eligibility: EWS, LIG and middle-income urban households without a pucca house; ownership or co-ownership in a woman's name is preferred.
benefits: Interest subsidy up to Rs 2.67 lakh on home loans under CLSS, and central assistance for building or upgrading houses for EWS and LIG families.
how_to_apply: Apply through the urban local body or a lending bank under the credit linked subsidy scheme.
documents_required: Aadhaar, income proof, bank details, property documents.

eligibility: Awareness and convergence programme in selected districts; individual benefits flow through linked schemes such as Sukanya Samriddhi.
benefits: Improvement of the child sex ratio and girls' education through school enrolment drives, girls' toilet facilities and scholarship linkages.
how_to_apply: Participate through schools and anganwadi centres; there is no direct cash application.
documents_required: Not applicable; linked schemes have their own document lists.

eligibility: Women entrepreneurs and SC or ST entrepreneurs setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, trading or agri-allied activity.
benefits: Bank loans from Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore with handholding support, and a RuPay debit card for working capital.
how_to_apply: Apply through any bank branch or the Stand Up India portal with a business plan.
documents_required: Business plan, KYC documents, caste certificate if applicable, project cost estimates.

eligibility: Adult women from poor households listed in SECC data or meeting the notified deprivation criteria, and several expanded categories.
benefits: Free LPG gas connection without deposit, free first refill and stove under Ujjwala 2.0, and an option to pay for refills in instalments.
how_to_apply: Apply at the nearest Indane, HP or Bharatgas distributor or on the PMUY portal.
documents_required: Aadhaar, ration card, bank account, self-declaration of household status.

eligibility: Working women away from their home town with income below the prescribed limit, including trainees; children up to 18 years can stay.
benefits: Safe and affordable accommodation with a day care facility for children, run by implementing organisations with grant support.
how_to_apply: Contact the nearest implementing organisation listed with the state women and child development department.
documents_required: Employment proof, identity proof, income certificate.

eligibility: Children aged 6 months to 6 years of working mothers.
benefits: Day care with sleeping facilities, supplementary nutrition, growth monitoring, health checkups and immunisation support at a nominal charge.
how_to_apply: Register at a nearby approved creche or through the anganwadi system.
documents_required: Child's birth certificate, parent's employment proof, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Children under 6 years, pregnant women, lactating mothers and adolescent girls.
benefits: Supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, health checkups, immunisation and referral services at anganwadi centres.
how_to_apply: Enrol at the nearest anganwadi centre; tracking is available on the Poshan Tracker app.
documents_required: Mother-child protection card, Aadhaar, ration card.

eligibility: Women aged 18 or above in difficult circumstances without social or economic support, such as widows, deserted women and women affected by violence.
benefits: Shelter, food, clothing, counselling, legal aid, vocational training and rehabilitation support.
how_to_apply: Approach the district women and child development office or a Swadhar Greh organisation directly.
documents_required: Identity proof; case registration is done by the centre.

eligibility: Any woman affected by physical, sexual, emotional, psychological or economic violence, irrespective of age, class, caste or education status.
benefits: Integrated support in one place - police facilitation, medical aid, legal aid, psycho-social counselling, temporary shelter for 5 days and video conferencing facilities.
how_to_apply: Call the women helpline 181 or walk in to the nearest One Stop Centre.
documents_required: No documents are mandatory to seek help.

scheme_name: STEP - Support to Training and Employment for Women
eligibility: Women above 16 years from marginalised groups seeking skill training.
benefits: Short-duration skill training in areas such as agriculture, handloom, handicrafts, hospitality and care services, with certification and placement linkage.
how_to_apply: Apply through an empanelled STEP project implementing agency.
documents_required: Aadhaar, education certificate where required, bank account.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
eligibility: Citizens aged 60 or above living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly old age pension - central assistance of Rs 200 per month for ages 60 to 79 and Rs 500 per month for 80 plus; many states add a top-up.
how_to_apply: Apply at the gram panchayat or municipal office, or on the state social welfare portal.
documents_required: Age proof, BPL or ration card, Aadhaar, bank account.

eligibility: Any citizen aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank account who is not an income tax payer.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month from age 60 depending on the contribution; the same pension continues to the spouse and the corpus goes to the nominee.
how_to_apply: Open the account through your bank with the APY form and monthly auto-debit.
documents_required: Aadhaar, bank account, nomination details, mobile number.

eligibility: Unorganised sector workers aged 18 to 40 with monthly income up to Rs 15,000.
benefits: Pension of Rs 3,000 per month after age 60 with the government matching the contribution 50:50; family pension of 50 percent to the spouse.
how_to_apply: Enrol at a Common Service Centre or on the Maandhan portal with eKYC.
documents_required: Aadhaar, savings bank account, mobile number.

eligibility: Senior citizens living below the poverty line with age-related disabilities such as low vision, hearing impairment, loss of teeth or locomotor disability.
benefits: Free assistive devices of ISI-marked quality - walking sticks, walkers, hearing aids, spectacles, wheelchairs and artificial dentures.
how_to_apply: Register through the district social welfare office; distribution camps are organised by ALIMCO with the district administration.
documents_required: Aadhaar, BPL certificate, medical assessment of the disability.

eligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years or above.
benefits: Assured pension for 10 years by investing up to Rs 15 lakh; pension paid monthly, quarterly or yearly at a fixed rate, with loan and premature exit facilities.
how_to_apply: Purchase the scheme through a LIC office or on the LIC online portal.
documents_required: Age proof, KYC documents, bank account.

scheme_name: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly
eligibility: All senior citizens; services are available at community health centres, district hospitals and medical colleges.
benefits: Dedicated geriatric outpatient departments, day care and rehabilitation services, physiotherapy and bed-side assistance for the elderly.
how_to_apply: Visit the geriatric OPD of the district hospital; no enrolment is needed.
documents_required: Aadhaar or any identity proof.

eligibility: All senior citizens aged 60 or above and their caregivers.
benefits: Free national helpline for information, guidance, emotional support and rescue or assistance for abused or abandoned elderly, connecting to local partner organisations.
how_to_apply: Call 14567 from any phone.
documents_required: Not required; the helpline records the complaint and details.

eligibility: All citizens aged 70 or above are covered irrespective of income through the Ayushman Vay Vandana card; BPL and SECC-listed families are covered at any age.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to Rs 5 lakh per family per year at empanelled hospitals for over 1,900 medical procedures.
how_to_apply: Verify or enrol on the PM-JAY portal, at a Common Service Centre or at an empanelled hospital help desk.
documents_required: Aadhaar, ration or income documents as applicable.

eligibility: Indigent senior citizens aged 65 or above who are eligible for old age pension but are not receiving it.
benefits: 10 kg of food grains free every month.
how_to_apply: Apply through the gram panchayat or municipality to the district social welfare office.
documents_required: Age proof, declaration of non-receipt of pension, Aadhaar.

eligibility: Destitute senior citizens, reached through implementing voluntary organisations; NGOs apply for the grants.
benefits: Grants for running old age homes providing food, clothing, shelter and medical care, continuous care homes and mobile medicare units.
how_to_apply: The district administration identifies beneficiaries; organisations apply for grants through the ministry's e-Anudaan portal.
documents_required: Identity proof and BPL status of the beneficiary.

eligibility: Individuals aged 60 or above (55 plus for voluntary retirement cases); deposit up to Rs 30 lakh.
benefits: Fixed quarterly interest higher than bank fixed deposit rates, a five-year term extendable by three years, and income tax benefit under section 80C.
how_to_apply: Open the account at any post office or bank branch.
documents_required: Age proof, identity proof, PAN, photographs.

scheme_name: National Action Plan for Senior Citizens
eligibility: All senior citizens, delivered through state governments and partner organisations.
benefits: Umbrella programme covering old age homes, elderline services, awareness about elder rights and the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, research and training.
how_to_apply: Benefits are delivered through state social welfare departments and partner organisations.
documents_required: Varies by component of the plan.
